subject: Next steps: procurement path & approver matrix for Tria Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@triahealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: procurement & approvals — Tria Health

Liam, thanks again for the call this morning — quick recap and a few asks so we can align next steps.

Recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: billing reconciliation automation for ambulatory clinics (pilot across 25 clinics).
- Expected ARR band: $80k–$120k annual for pilot -> roll into multi-year in year 2.
- Technical contact: Monique (procurement) will handle PO request; Legal signatory is Michael O'Neil.

Procurement / commercial topics we flagged:
1) PO vs card: you mentioned procurement issues for purchases > $10k per year requiring a PO; small card purchases under $10k are possible but finance prefers PO for contracts.
2) Marketplace: you said Tria is open to AWS Marketplace but needs 1) marketplace invoice model and 2) pricing parity confirmation.
3) Approvals: we need the name/email of the budget owner and finance sponsor to include on the mutual action plan.
4) Timeline: rough PO approval estimate ~3 weeks once procurement opens ticket.

Next steps / asks (can you confirm by EOD Wednesday?):
- Confirm Budget Owner (name + title + email) and Finance Sponsor contact.
- Confirm whether Tria requires any internal PO forms or a procurement portal link.
- Confirm desired contract term (12/24 months) and any auto-renew constraints.

Attaching: procurement_checklist.pdf (form), pricing_summary.xlsx (estimate).

If helpful I can draft a short mutual action plan for procurement to review — CC'd Camila and Monica to help scope legal / CS timelines.

Thanks,
-- 
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0199
From: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@triahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement & approvals — Tria Health

On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 3:12 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Liam, thanks again for the call this morning — quick recap and a few asks so we can align next steps.

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers below to help you and your team prep: 

- Budget Owner: Monique Renaud, Director of Revenue Ops — monique.renaud@triahealth.com. Monique owns the pilot budget and will sign the internal request.
- Finance Sponsor: Michael O'Neil, VP Contracts & Procurement — m.oneil@triahealth.com. He is the legal signatory for MSA/PO.
- PO vs card: Our Finance policy requires a PO for any commitment over $10k annually. Cards are allowed for ad-hoc purchases under $10k but not preferred for vendor contracts.
- Marketplace: Interest in AWS Marketplace but must verify that Redwood can offer invoiced/contracted terms via marketplace or provide consolidated billing options. If Marketplace supports contract flow, procurement is open to it — we need confirmation on invoice cadence and tax handling.
- Timeline: Procurement ticket typically takes ~2–3 weeks; legal review for our standard MSA is usually 1 week after procurement approves. Overall estimate: 3–4 weeks to have PO and signed MSA for a standard setup.

I'll open the procurement ticket today and loop Monique and Michael. If you can share the procurement checklist and a short MAP, that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Barnes
Head of Revenue Operations | Tria Health
liam.barnes@triahealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@triahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: procurement & approvals — Tria Health

Camila / Monica — forwarding Liam's confirmation. Key items for our internal plan:

- Budget owner: Monique Renaud (Director, Revenue Ops) — primary approver for pilot.
- Legal/Signatory: Michael O'Neil (VP Contracts) — will sign MSA + PO.
- PO requirement kicks in > $10k annually; timeline ~3–4 weeks.
- Marketplace: prospect is open but needs confirmation on invoicing and contractual flow.

Can you please: 
1) Camila — prepare a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that calls out procurement steps, expected artifacts (PO form, vendor onboarding), and a proposed target date for PO issuance. Share as a doc we can send to Monique.
2) Monica — confirm billing options: 1) invoiced PO net-30, 2) marketplace billing (if supported), and 3) card fallback. Also confirm whether we can provide consolidated invoicing across regions.

I attached the procurement_checklist and pricing_summary in the previous thread. Also recommend we propose a 12-month pilot with an option to extend.

Thanks — will coordinate next steps with Liam once we have the MAP and billing clarity.

—
Karthik
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@triahealth.com>, Monique Renaud <monique.renaud@triahealth.com>, Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@triahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps for Tria Health (procurement)

Liam / Monique / Michael — looping in the MAP draft and next steps. Attaching MAP-tria-draft.docx and SOW-template.docx for your review.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Week 0: Redwood sends MAP + procurement checklist + pricing summary (attached).
- Week 1: Tria opens procurement ticket and provides vendor onboarding forms + PO request. Monique to own submission.
- Week 2: Redwood legal shares redlines (if any) to MSA; parallel work on SOW and kickoff scheduling.
- Week 3: Procurement approves PO; Michael signs MSA; Redwood issues first invoice (net-30) or enables marketplace billing if preferred.

Items to confirm now: PO form attachment (if Tria has a specific template), any required W-9 or tax docs, and whether the pilot requires an SLA addendum.

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Attachments: MAP-tria-draft.docx (DOCX stub), SOW-template.docx (DOCX stub)
